description: Component for micro-batch Oracle CDC via LogMiner.

outputs.description: Sensor run requests carrying a batch of insert/update/delete row changes

service_name.label: Service Name
service_name.description: Oracle service name. Set this OR sid.

sid.label: Sid
sid.description: Oracle SID. Set this OR service_name.

username.label: Username
username.description: Oracle username. Needs SELECT_CATALOG_ROLE (or explicit SELECT on V$LOGMNR_CONTENTS/V$ARCHIVED_LOG/V$DATABASE) and EXECUTE on DBMS_LOGMNR, plus LogMiner access to the tracked schema's supplementally-logged columns.

password_env_var.label: Password Env Var
password_env_var.description: Environment variable holding the Oracle password

schema_name.label: Schema Name
schema_name.description: Which Oracle schema (SEG_OWNER) to track. This sensor tracks exactly ONE schema -- declare one sensor per schema if you need more than one.

table_patterns.label: Table Patterns
table_patterns.description: fnmatch-style glob patterns (e.g. 'ORDERS', 'ORDER_ITEMS_*') matched against table names within `schema_name`. Resolved against ALL_TABLES at the start of every tick (not cached).

job_name.label: Job Name
job_name.description: Name of the job to trigger when changes are detected

minimum_interval_seconds.label: Minimum Interval Seconds
minimum_interval_seconds.description: Minimum time (in seconds) between sensor evaluations

max_events_per_tick.label: Max Events Per Tick
max_events_per_tick.description: Caps how many row-change events this sensor processes in one tick. Unset (default): no cap. When the cap is hit, the stored SCN only advances to the last event actually processed.

on_first_run.label: On First Run
on_first_run.description: 'start_now' (default) -- start capturing changes from the database's CURRENT SCN on the very first tick; pair with a separate one-time snapshot/full-load of existing rows. 'from_beginning' -- start from the EARLIEST SCN still covered by an archived log in V$ARCHIVED_LOG. Fails loudly via skip_reason if no archived logs are available at all.

op_name.label: Op Name
op_name.description: Op name to key the run_config under. Emitted as `{'ops': {op_name: {'config': {...}}}}`.

source_asset_key.label: Source Asset Key
source_asset_key.description: Optional asset key to receive an AssetObservation on every tick that yields changes. Metadata includes schema_name, tables, event_count, inserts, updates, deletes, start_scn, end_scn.

default_status.label: Default Status
default_status.description: Default status of the sensor (running or stopped)

emit_materialization.label: Emit Materialization
emit_materialization.description: When True (default), emit AssetMaterialization on the target asset key. When False, emit AssetObservation instead -- free of Dagster+ credit charges, but downstream conditions gating on ~any_deps_missing() (including eager()) will not fire.
